name: elite-dangerous-mcp
description: Elite Dangerous tools for Claude: your game journal, Inara, EDSM, Frontier CAPI and Spansh, with build plans, engineering, materials, trade routes and station searches.

ed_journal_dir.title: Journal folder
ed_journal_dir.description: Optional. The Elite Dangerous journal folder. On the gaming PC, leave empty for the default. On another computer, choose the synced copy.

ed_mcp_sync_dir.title: Sync folder
ed_mcp_sync_dir.description: Optional. A folder that Google Drive, iCloud Drive, OneDrive or Syncthing keeps in step, so plans and preferences follow you between computers.

ed_mcp_sync_password.title: Sync password
ed_mcp_sync_password.description: Optional, at least 12 characters. Encrypts your API keys and Frontier login. Use the same password on every computer.
